x: Books and exam keys give the Indian Mackerel as India's national fish, so it is keyed; no national fish has been formally notified. Hilsa is the national fish of Bangladesh, and the Ganges river dolphin is India's National Aquatic Animal (2009).

dispute: Most books and keys: Indian Mackerel. Strictly: the Government of India has never formally notified a national fish (app notes 4:29; general knowledge, not checked).

from_notes: Russell's Viper ... Its hemotoxic venom is a very potent coagulant, which damages tissue as well as blood cells.
x: Local necrosis, bruising (ecchymosis), blistering, painful swelling and compartment syndrome are signs of haemotoxic, tissue-damaging viper venom. Sea snakes are mainly neurotoxic/myotoxic and the rat snake is non-venomous.
source: Shankar Environment 12 (.ocr) p.10 (Russell's viper, haemotoxic venom); symptom list: general knowledge, not checked
